name: coder-fleet-roster
description: A live roster of this session's subagents: who is running, what tool each is on right now, how long it has taken, and what it answered.

autoOpen.title: Open the roster when a subagent starts
autoOpen.description: Open the Roster pane the first time a subagent starts (it docks from 144 columns). Closing it by hand stops this for the session.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Which agent endings raise a toast: all (done and failed), failures, or off.
